expansionSections.heading: How The New Medicine Service Works

deepDiveBlocks.heading: Support When Starting New Medicines
paragraphs: The NHS New Medicine Service provides structured follow-up when you start selected new medicines — helping identify problems early and improve adherence.
A pharmacist discusses how to take your medicine, checks for side effects at follow-up, and refers to your GP if concerns arise.
